t: You're at Orme Square, a private square in Bayswater, just off the north side of Bayswater Road. It sits on the north-west corner of Hyde Park, overlooking Kensington Gardens, and the Orme Gate entrance to the gardens takes its name from the square. Two people are linked to it. Emelia Russell Gurney, an English campaigner for women's higher education, died here in 1896. And David Lascelles, the present Earl of Harewood, a film and television producer, was born here.
